class.name: NetwSynchronizers
class.brief_description: Which [MultiplayerSynchronizer] nodes govern a node, and what they govern on it.
class.description: A tree walk with a cache in front of it. The answer is stored on the target's own metadata under [method meta_key] and reused until a cached synchronizer stops governing the target, so the walk costs once per shape rather than once per ask. It has no instance, because "which synchronizers point at this node" is a question about the tree rather than about a session. [codeblock] for sync: MultiplayerSynchronizer in NetwSynchronizers.of_node(root): sync.set_visibility_for(peer, false) [/codeblock] A synchronizer governs a node when its [member MultiplayerSynchronizer.root_path] resolves to it. Off the tree that path resolves to nothing, so a synchronizer parented to the target counts instead: an entity is configured and read before it is seated, and a walk that answered nothing there would report an unsynchronized node.

method.name: assign_value
method.description: Writes [param value] at [param path] under [param target], resolving the node and the property in one step. A path that resolves to no property writes nothing rather than writing onto the base.

method.name: clear_cache
method.description: Drops [param target]'s cached list, so the next [method of_node] walks the tree again.

method.name: display_bindings
method.description: The [code][key, node, property][/code] triples [param sync] replicates, resolved against [param root]. [code]key[/code] is the [code]replication_config[/code] path, so a receive handler maps a decoded payload key straight to its target. Unresolved paths are skipped.

method.name: governed_targets
method.description: The normalized [code][object, sub_path][/code] targets [param sync] governs, resolved against [param root]. Two synchronizers overlap when they share an entry, which is the key overlap detection reads.

method.name: meta_key
method.description: The metadata a node's cached synchronizer list is stored under.

method.name: of_node
method.description: Every [MultiplayerSynchronizer] that governs [param target]. Cached on the target once it is inside the tree, and re-walked whenever a cached entry has stopped governing it. An off-tree answer is never cached, because it was taken before the node learned where it lives.

method.name: owned_by
method.description: The subset of [method of_node] that [param target] also owns, which is what separates a synchronizer belonging to this scene from one an inner scene brought with it. In the editor a node's owner is the scene root rather than [param target] itself, so a synchronizer is also counted as owned when its owner is [param target]'s own owner.

method.name: resolve_value
method.description: The value at [param path] under [param target], or [code]null[/code] when the path resolves to no property.

method.name: synchronized_properties
method.description: Every property path the synchronizers [param target] owns replicate, keyed by the property's own name and valued by the raw [NodePath].

method.name: sync_only_server
method.description: Restricts every synchronizer on [param target] to the server peer. Peer [code]0[/code] is every peer, so clearing it and then naming the server is what makes an exception rather than a second grant.
